subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: After the cleanup blocker is fixed, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1054 become the single supported private AWS workspace implementation?
rationale: Both branches add a large permanent deployment and configuration surface but differ materially in IAM and credential boundaries; repository history cannot choose the intended product contract.

options.title: Adopt the successor
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1054 as the landing branch after carrying the cleanup repair and obtaining exact-head AWS proof.

options.title: Adopt this branch
options.body: Keep this PR canonical, repair uncertain-launch release behavior here, reconcile desired successor hardening, and rerun the exact-head canary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the successor
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1054 as the landing branch after carrying the cleanup repair and obtaining exact-head AWS proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from current-main AWS history and authored the competing implementation work, although formal decision authority is not established by git history alone.
